surfaces.verification: Two separately scoped 22C3 uses; both CLIO cargos; T-DM1 3.5 mean and plasma-context species; distinct dates stay visible; identical nested citations share their containing citation.
Named registry facility without a posted status; missing status remains unknown. Fictional tests distinguish measured zero slots from no reported slots. Native disclosure keyboard behavior checked.

Atomic scoped passages retain subject/context/date; separate similar claims are not collapsed by approximate deduplication. Scoped claims prevent a global no-approval verdict. Cargo bundles appear in mechanism/comparison answers; named trial access remains distinct from overall status.
Both cargos are one bundle, not two single-cargo grid entries. Delivery targets are explicit. Missing classes/loading stay unresolved, and the single sourced mean is exact.
JSON retains structured source data; Markdown includes scoped observations as JSON with dates and source URLs. Final exported checks recorded separately.

limits: The original assay category/year filters remain summaries of the retained registry fields; detailed intended-use observations are separate. This does not revalidate all inherited assay data.
Alternative renderings such as CSV and RDF are not claimed to carry every observation property; full scoped data are in entity JSON and Markdown.
The esophageal 22C3 use review remains open in the content audit.
Expert review, upstream-accessible preview and owner approval remain pending.
Legacy derivative and explicitly joined dual-cargo rules are corrected in the follow-up receipt; all possible legacy prose composition is not certified.
